chapters.title: A Physics Toolkit
chapters.note: Start with units and graphs; do not begin with advanced atomic energy equations.

chapters.title: Representing Motion
chapters.note: Define the coordinate axis before interpreting signed displacement.

equations.name: Displacement
equations.conditions: Signed change in position in one dimension.

equations.conditions: Displacement per elapsed time; slope on a position–time graph.

equations.name: Average speed
equations.conditions: Uses total path length, not signed displacement.

equations.conditions: One-dimensional constant-a relationship.

equations.name: Free fall from rest
equations.conditions: Distance downward, g ≈ 9.8 m/s²; neglect air resistance.

equations.conditions: Vector sum of external forces on the chosen object.

equations.conditions: g is downward gravitational field strength.

equations.name: Vertical equilibrium
equations.conditions: Only when vertical acceleration is zero; normal force need not always equal mg.
